What I read, in my words:
   line 1: the hall starts where you are, and it is ahead of you.
   line 2: there is a front door behind you, at the start of the hall.
   line 3: there is a door at the end of the hall, in front of you. it goes to the living room.
   line 4: there is a door 2 metres down the hall, on your left.
   line 4: there is a door 2 metres down the hall, on your right.
   the hall is 4 metres long.
   the hall is 1 metre wide.
What I chose:
   line 4: I read 'right' as right-side (a side), not as right (a rule): it is after 'and'.
What you do not say (the plan shows it as not known):
   how wide a door is. I draw each door 0.8 metres wide.
   what is past the door on the left.
   what is past the door on the right.
